title: Get Credit for What's Already on Your Resume (Teal Job Matcher)
description:
-----------------------------------------------------
Learn how to match your resume to a job description in Teal's Job Matcher — now rebuilt to read phrases, topics, and themes the way a hiring manager does, instead of hunting for exact-word matches.

The Job Matcher pulls the hard skills and soft skills out of any job posting, shows you which ones your resume already covers, and weights what the requirements section actually asks for. No more guessing at which resume skills matter for the role.

 Sign up for your free Teal account & get your resume job-ready: https://tealhq.co/3VYY8LN

  Match your resume to any job description with Teal's Job Matcher: https://tealhq.co/3xjbt78

  Get the free Chrome Extension: https://tealhq.co/3PLFGlA

  More job search and career advice: https://tealhq.co/4az6CNB

In this video, learn how to:
 Add a saved job to the Job Matcher and get a resume match score (Teal+)
 See the hard skills and soft skills a job description is asking for
 Read the red, yellow, and green states — and what yellow is telling you
 Get credit for word forms and related phrases, not just exact matches
 Group by job description section so requirements outweigh nice-to-haves
 Fill a missing requirement without leaving the matcher
 Add skills fast and ignore the terms that don't matter for the role

 Come hang with us here:
– TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@teal_hq
– LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/teal_hq
– Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/teal_hq

Teal is a personal career growth platform that gives you the tools, skills, and recommendations you need to accelerate your career, starting with the job search. Our mission is to simplify your search, empower you to take control of your career, and help you land roles that value your skills.
